turns.text: Who can participate in the ABDM Sandbox?

must_contain: any entity or individual can potentially participate in the ABDM sandbox
examples include an HMIS, an LMIS, a PHR app and a health tech company
notes: NHA's own pages disagree on who can participate: this case requires 'any entity or individual can potentially participate', while faq-verbatim-abdm-sandbox-07 requires the stricter entity-eligibility answer and faq-verbatim-abdm-sandbox-15 requires that citizens and healthcare professionals do not register directly. The conflict is NHA's, across its own pages, not ours.
